@ a call of a function that is not rt of an init input in a sample expression
render hoist_non_rt_calls.at_sample sr=0x41000000 cfg f=0x40800000 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40400000]
@ a call of constants only in a block expression
render hoist_non_rt_calls.at_block sr=0x41000000 params g=0x40400000 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000]
@ the call in a let of its own
render hoist_non_rt_calls.in_a_let sr=0x41000000 cfg f=0x40c00000 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000]
@ a call of init inside a part of block
render hoist_non_rt_calls.nested sr=0x41000000 cfg a=0x40400000 params n=0x40000000 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000]
@ the call is made once at init: process again with another n reads the same make(a)
init 0 hoist_non_rt_calls.nested sr=0x41000000 cfg a=0x40400000
process 0 params n=0x40000000 frames=1 in x=[0x3f800000]
process 0 params n=0x3f000000 frames=1 in x=[0x3f800000]
@ a call that panics is an init part: it panics at init
init 0 hoist_non_rt_calls.panics_at_init sr=0x41000000 cfg n=0
panic init
@ the call that gives its value: inv(4) = 25
render hoist_non_rt_calls.panics_at_init sr=0x41000000 cfg n=4 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000]
@ a call of init inside a part of block panics at init
init 0 hoist_non_rt_calls.panics_inside_a_block_part sr=0x41000000 cfg a=0
panic init
@ a call of sample_rate() is an init part: design(4.0) = 2.0
